words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He moved to Texas last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年搬到了德克萨斯州。
words.en: Texas is a state in the southern central part of the United States, known for its size, history, and culture.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: He wants a short-term job before going to university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前想找一份短期工作。
words.en: relating to a period of time that is not long, especially a few weeks or months

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.ex: The room is slightly warmer than before.
words.ex_cn: 房间比以前稍微暖和一点。
words.en: To a small degree; not considerably.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.tr: adj. 团结的；联合的；统一的； v. （使）团结；（使）联合；（使）统一；“unite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The united team won the match.
words.ex_cn: 这个团结的团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: If people are united, they all agree about something or are working together for the same aim.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: adj. 增进知识的；提供消息的；
words.ex: The documentary is very informative.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片非常增进了知识。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information.

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大叫着求救。
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.
